title: Nkosi sikelel' iAfrika (God Bless Africa)
license: © CVET; reuse with attribution, non-commercial educational use only
notes: South Africa / Zambia, c. 1989-90; isiXhosa, isiZulu, English. A freedom song and toyi-toyi from the stands at Soccer City, Walter Sisulu held at the microphone, a Soweto community hall welcoming him with song, his black-power salute over Nkosi sikelel' iAfrika, then the Zambian anthem sung by Kenneth Kaunda in Lusaka and the South African anthem on Govan Mbeki's face. Every sung window is 10 s and the reel is baked with --distort 0.5 under the Tier B music rule; the 30 s long window is Sisulu SPEAKING, not a song.
